Title: A read-only web service operation returns its result for known identifiers
Step Action: Send a SOAP POST for the operation and arguments in the row.

Step Expected: The body is a SOAP envelope.

Title: A read-only web service operation answers with a SOAP envelope for unknown identifiers
Step Action: Send a SOAP POST for the operation with empty identifiers.

Step Expected: The body is a SOAP envelope.

Step Action: Check that the body is not an HTML page.
Step Expected: No HTML error page is returned.
The status is 200 or 500 with a soap:Fault.
